community_list_entries.name: STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid?

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark of 400 implicit-conflict scenarios (1,200 queries) embedded in long user-assistant histories (LongMemEval distractor sessions, up to 150K tokens). It tests detecting and acting on outdated user-state memories.
